description: Checks a visit time the buyer stated in chat, or lists up to three times the dealership is open. It sends nothing, and it never picks a time: the buyer picks. The buyer must have gone ahead with this car before the time can be sent.

idempotencyKey.description: A key you made up for this request: 1 to 255 printable characters. book_visit sends with the same key.

slot.description: The visit time the buyer stated. Leave it out to list the times the dealership is open.

instant.description: The visit time the buyer stated, in UTC, for example 2026-11-12T18:00:00.000Z, or any ISO 8601 time with a zone.

name: visit_times
title: See times to visit
